title: Houthi Ballistic Missile Aimed at Riyadh Intercepted — First Strike Attempt on Capital
detail: The Saudi-led coalition's Royal Saudi Air Defense Forces intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile fired by the Houthis toward Riyadh at dawn on Sept 19, 2026 — the first time the Saudi capital has been targeted since fighting escalated as a spillover of the wider Iran war. Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Maliki said attempted attacks on Bisha, Taif, Farasan and Yanbu were also thwarted by air defenses. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said the group had launched cruise missiles, ballistic missiles and drones at 'sensitive' sites in Riyadh and an Aramco facility in Yanbu. Saudi authorities reported no casualties or damage in Riyadh, where a plume of smoke was seen near King Khalid International Airport; separately, 12 Houthi fighters and 13 Yemeni government soldiers were reported killed in ground clashes in Taiz and Lahj the same day. Jordan's Foreign Ministry and the UN condemned the attacks on civilian infrastructure.
